cover_headline: Malaysia Ends Visa-Free Entry for Indians From January 1, 2027; Applications Open December 1
facts: Malaysia will discontinue the 30-day visa exemption for Indian citizens from January 1, 2027
Visa applications open on December 1, 2026 through the MyVISA portal
Indians can still enter visa-free until December 31, 2026, for stays of up to 30 days

end.headline: Malaysia Ends Visa-Free Entry for Indians From January 1, 2027; Applications Open December 1
end.line: It is your arrival date, not your booking date, that decides whether you need a visa.
